Decide whether this exchange contains a strawman.

Label NONE if Claim B fairly paraphrases Claim A, asks a genuine clarifying question (even a pointed one), or disagrees with what Claim A actually says.

Claim B: I was wrong that archiving is the only purpose. So are you saying libraries shouldn't have ANY objectionable content? Or is your issue specifically about visual depictions, or about what counts as literature? [lists possible alternate readings, invites correction]
